description: The Figshare deposit provides a continuous soil-moisture series for the Tibetan Plateau from 2002 to 2015. The Scientific Data descriptor says the GeoTIFF grids have 0.25-degree resolution and include reconstructed moisture alongside original ECV moisture and auxiliary land-surface variables. They can inform drought, runoff or land-surface forcing in water-system simulations across the Plateau. The reconstructed field comes from satellite observations and a general-regression neural network; it should not be treated as an independent in-situ measurement. Model users need to distinguish reconstructed values from raw inputs and consider the coarse grid when studying local catchments. The own Figshare item lists the RAR archive and CC BY 4.0 licence. I read its metadata and the article Data Records without downloading or decompressing the archive. No exact catalogue record was found.
